recap.text: Bolts of energy leave the caster's eyes. Princess Donut learns the spell after Mordecai switches on her menus. At level five, she chooses to put three to six mana into each bolt. A six leaves a level-two troglodyte a burnt-out husk.

beats.headline: Bolts from the eyes of a Persian
beats.text: Bolts of energy leave the caster’s eyes one after another, and the resemblance to a film about spaceships is close enough that nobody bothers to pretend otherwise. Princess Donut works it out for herself once Mordecai has switched her menus on, and from that point the question is never whether she will fire, only at what.
beats.gist: Energy bolts leave the caster's eyes; Princess Donut fires them after Mordecai switches her menus on.

beats.headline: Three to six
beats.text: At level five the spell lets the caster choose how much mana goes into each bolt, from three to six. At an intelligence of twenty-four that is eight missiles at three a piece, or a smaller number of bigger ones. A six leaves a level-two troglodyte a burnt-out husk. The man points out that a three would have done it. The cat's position is that anything about to bite her face off is getting a six.
beats.gist: At level five, Magic Missile lets the caster put three to six mana into each bolt.
